svg.text: same fitted model; nothing is refitted
Repeat n_repeats times, shuffling differently each time, for importances_mean and importances_std.
Then do the whole thing again for every other column.
Shuffling breaks the link between one column and the target, so the score drop estimates what the fitted model was relying on.
